title: ORSA Readiness Pack
description: Deterministic ORSA readiness arithmetic over caller-declared synthetic inputs, checked against the duties inserted into Solvency II by Directive (EU) 2025/2: the two long-term climate scenarios of Article 45a(2) and the liquidity risk management plan of Article 144a(2). Computes scenarios_missing as the declared required set minus the declared run set, liquidity_plan as DOCUMENTED or MISSING, and an overall READY or NOT_READY verdict. No undertaking, no scenario engine, no supervisor, no network, no clock.

scenarios_required.description: Declared required scenario set; the directive pair is orderly_transition and disorderly_transition (Art 45a(2)).

scenarios_run.description: Declared scenario set actually run; may be empty.

liquidity_plan_documented.description: True when a liquidity risk management plan is documented and up to date (Art 144a(2)).

capital_contingency_note.description: Optional declared capital-contingency note, echoed into the trace verbatim.

board_sign_off_reference.description: Optional declared board sign-off record pointer, echoed into the trace verbatim.

scenarios_missing.description: Required set minus run set, declared order preserved; null on the fail-closed path.

liquidity_plan.description: Read of the declared liquidity-plan flag.

trace.description: Full set-difference and flag trace, or the fail-closed reasons naming each rejected input.

overall.description: READY only when nothing is missing and the plan is documented.

mcp_tool_definition.name: compute_orsa_readiness_pack
mcp_tool_definition.description: Computes an ORSA readiness pack from declared inputs: scenarios_missing as the declared required climate scenario set minus the declared run set (Directive (EU) 2025/2 Art 45a(2) pair as the documentary default), liquidity_plan from the declared documentation flag (Art 144a(2)), and an overall READY or NOT_READY verdict. Readiness arithmetic over caller-declared synthetic inputs only: no materiality assessment, no legal advice, and nothing is filed anywhere.

liquidity_plan_documented.description: true when the liquidity plan is documented

source: authored by ORSA-READINESS-BUILD-1 per ORSA-READINESS-BUILD-SPEC.md. Primary text (SO #38): Directive (EU) 2025/2 Art 45a(2) and Art 144a(2) quoted in the kernel source and in board/queued/ORSA-READINESS-BUILD-1.md before any constant landed. Scope positioning: a readiness checker over caller-declared synthetic inputs, not legal advice, not a materiality assessment, and not a supervisory submission; absent or invalid inputs are refused fail-closed and named, never silently repaired.
